title: Offline emission-path falsifier on the packet-of-record v3 heuristic signals under the shipped emission repair + anchor classifier
why_this_instrument: Ordered work (1) of the v63 evaluation question requires this lane to re-score the mapping-free counter_authority_surface gates on regenerated bundles once remedy (a) lands in the product. Remedy (a) HAS landed on the accepted product mount fe219a19 (product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py sha256 9764a37e... contains strip_redaction_placeholders). The served packet 39319405429 was built BEFORE the emission repair was integrated (each bundle's provenance.counter_emission_repair is ABSENT while provenance.adversarial_retrieval.component is adversarial_retrieval/2). The packet still carries 8/8/4 heuristic signals with non-empty evidence on de/fr/it. The last two accepted cycles re-scored the SAME static packet bytes through mapping_free_recall_falsifier and both returned PRODUCT_FALSIFIED with n_issued=0 (runs 39852758814 and 39854748616) — that re-verification is discharged and is NOT this experiment. What has NOT been measured is the SHIPPED offline emission PATH on those existing heuristic signals: apply_counter_emission_repair (vendored frontier-counter-label-emission, Outcome A) followed by apply_anchor_labels (vendored frontier-counter-anchor-classifier, Outcome A) as product/query/pipeline.py wires them between adversarial_retrieval_pass and apply_anchor_labels. This instrument is the smallest executable falsification of that path on the product mount's own accepted bytes.
hypothesis: On the accepted product mount fe219a19, the shipped offline emission path (apply_counter_emission_repair then apply_anchor_labels under the default abstain-and-disclose mode) applied to the packet-of-record v3 bundles' existing heuristic signals (H_E1): promotes exactly the rows that carry adversarial_retrieval_signal.heuristic_status with non-empty evidence (n_promoted equals that count per bundle); (H_E2): every promoted row becomes a frozen scored status before the anchor classifier runs; (H_E3): the three-number publication n_scored / n_abstained / n_emitted / yield is present beside the mapping-free counter_authority_surface gate; (H_E4): under the frozen rubric 4457e971... the classifier EMITS at least one scored counter row on at least one of the three languages OR the comparative map-versus-ranked-list half remains VACUOUS because n_emitted=0 on all three; (H_E5): the frozen mapping-free gate mf::counter_authority_surface (n_issued >= 1 AND n_with_empty_evidence == 0 under RULES_LABEL scored_statuses) is re-scored on the post-path bundle bytes and is reported honestly whether it passes or fails. A bounded negative is fully acceptable: if the classifier abstains on every promoted row, the product's comparative half stays VACUOUS and the frozen absolute bars stay REPORTED-ONLY and unmet; that is evidence, not a harness defect.
baseline: The same three served bundles' pre-path counter state on the accepted mount: counter_emission_repair provenance ABSENT, counter_anchor n_scored=0 / n_emitted=0 / n_abstained=0 / yield=0.0, mapping-free mf::counter_authority_surface n_issued=0 on all three (accepted runs 39852758814 and 39854748616, mount head fe219a197e4bfb129984a732ab9adca917556eac). The accepted emission charter measurement on the same packets (Outcome A_EMISSION_RECOVERED) reported n_scored 8/8/4 after repair with n_emitted=0 per bundle under the frozen rubric; this instrument re-derives those three numbers from the product mount's own seams and does not copy them.

gates_FROZEN.E1_promotion_matches_heuristic_signal_co: For each of de-kapitalverletzung / fr-bail-entretien / it-responsabilita-medica, n_promoted equals the count of decision rows whose adversarial_retrieval_signal.heuristic_status is non-empty and whose evidence is non-empty. Fail if promotion drops a signal row or invents one.
gates_FROZEN.E2_scored_statuses_after_repair: After apply_counter_emission_repair and before apply_anchor_labels, every promoted row carries a counter_status in RULES_LABEL.rubric.scored_statuses. Fail if any promoted row is outside the frozen vocabulary.
gates_FROZEN.E3_three_number_publication: After apply_anchor_labels, provenance.counter_anchor publishes n_scored, n_abstained, n_emitted and yield as numbers. Fail if any of the four is missing or non-numeric.
gates_FROZEN.E4_mapping_free_counter_surface_rescored: The frozen mapping-free predicate (imported from evaluation.mapping_free_recall_falsifier.counter_authority_surface; no re-derivation) is evaluated on the post-path bundle: n_issued = rows whose final counter_status is in scored_statuses; gate_pass = (n_issued >= 1 and n_with_empty_evidence == 0). The gate result is reported honestly; this instrument does not require it to pass.
gates_FROZEN.E5_multilingual_coverage: All three languages de / fr / it of the packet-of-record are measured and reported side by side. Fail if any language is silently dropped.

controls_FROZEN.C1_vendored_repair_rehash: product/query/counter_emission_repair.verify_vendored() must return ok=True; any digest mismatch invalidates the run (exit 2).
controls_FROZEN.C2_frozen_rubric_rehash: RULES_LABEL.json must re-hash to 4457e971df3dc5d10af2a727aa675afc15a15564c18eed4cede0af5eb41b4608 before and after the run.
controls_FROZEN.C3_blanked_promotion_control: A deliberately blanked copy of each bundle (all adversarial_retrieval_signal fields removed) must yield n_promoted=0 under apply_counter_emission_repair; a non-zero would make E1 vacuous.
controls_FROZEN.C4_zero_network: socket.socket.connect and socket.create_connection are wrapped fail-closed for the whole measurement; any call invalidates the run (exit 2).
controls_FROZEN.C5_anchor_classifier_nonvacuity: A planted row carrying a frozen scored status and the reason code vocabulary must be classified (not silently skipped) by apply_anchor_labels; the planted row is never counted in E1-E5.

exit_code_contract.0: PATH_MEASURED_NO_FALSIFICATION - every measured gate E1-E5 held on the exact accepted bytes and every control held; the product path is not falsified by THIS instrument (it does not mean the product is unblocked).
exit_code_contract.1: PRODUCT_PATH_FALSIFIED - at least one gate E1-E2 or E3 failed on the exact accepted bytes (promotion drop/invent, out-of-vocabulary status, or missing three-number publication).
exit_code_contract.2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS - a control failed, the mount is missing, a pin drifted, or the network guard fired; never a pass and never a bar-met.

claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: on the accepted product mount fe219a19 and the packet-of-record v3 bundle bytes, whether the shipped offline emission path (emission repair + anchor classifier as pipeline.py wires them) promotes the existing heuristic signals, publishes the three numbers, and what the frozen mapping-free counter_authority_surface predicate scores on the post-path bytes. It does NOT meet, move or re-derive the frozen absolute LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND bars; it does NOT lift either DO-NOT-SERVE order; it does NOT certify packet admission; it does NOT claim the map helps a jurist; it does NOT claim the comparative map-versus-ranked-list question is non-vacuous unless n_emitted>0 is measured; it does NOT rebuild the counter-anchor classifier or the emission repair; it does NOT run any obsolete universal-174k benchmark; human_gate_ready stays false.
reused_accepted_assets: packet-of-record v3 bundles under results/product/gate_packet/39319405429/questions (accepted product mount bytes)

strip_redaction_placeholders / remedy (a) is DISCLOSED as landed on the mount (adversarial_retrieval.py sha 9764a37e...) but is NOT re-verified here — that verification is accepted at results/evaluation/shipped_planner_remedy_verification/39813664201.json
pre_freeze_scratch_reconnaissance_DISCLO: Before this freeze record was written, a throwaway offline probe (python3 one-shot, not committed) applied apply_counter_emission_repair then apply_anchor_labels to the three served bundles and printed n_promoted / n_scored / n_emitted. Observed: de 8/8/0, fr 8/8/0, it 4/4/0 with abstention_reasons {'no_domain_anchor': 1, 'no_intent_marker': 2, 'pivot_absent': 5} on de. That probe is NOT a claim-bearing artifact; it motivated the freeze. Every gate above is still re-measured by the committed instrument under this run id, and the probe result may not be cited as the measurement of record.
